NOC MASTER COMMAND CENTER DEMO • KAFKA + REST + FILES
MinIO → Spark → Iceberg → Trino → Grafana

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.alarms WHERE severity_clean='CRITICAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.alarms
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.tickets
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.security_events
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.network_events WHERE severity_clean IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cnt), 0) AS value FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) cnt FROM iceberg.noc.alarms WHERE LOWER(source) LIKE '%rest%' OR LOWER(source) IN ('servicenow', 'trend micro', 'cyberark', 'generic rest')
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.tickets WHERE LOWER(source) LIKE '%rest%' OR LOWER(source) IN ('servicenow', 'trend micro', 'cyberark', 'generic rest')
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.network_events WHERE LOWER(source) LIKE '%rest%' OR LOWER(source) IN ('servicenow', 'trend micro', 'cyberark', 'generic rest')
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.security_events WHERE LOWER(source) LIKE '%rest%' OR LOWER(source) IN ('servicenow', 'trend micro', 'cyberark', 'generic rest')
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics WHERE LOWER(source) LIKE '%rest%' OR LOWER(source) IN ('servicenow', 'trend micro', 'cyberark', 'generic rest')
)

SELECT SUM(cnt) AS value FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) cnt FROM iceberg.noc.alarms WHERE source NOT LIKE 'REST_%'
        UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.tickets WHERE source NOT LIKE 'REST_%'
        UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.network_events WHERE source NOT LIKE 'REST_%'
        UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.security_events WHERE source NOT LIKE 'REST_%'
        UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics WHERE source NOT LIKE 'REST_%'
    )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.network_events WHERE severity_clean='CRITICAL'
SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.tickets
SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (10.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (8.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.tickets
SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (12.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics
SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (15.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.security_events
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.alarms WHERE severity_clean='MAJOR'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cnt), 0) AS value FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) cnt FROM iceberg.noc.alarms
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.tickets
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.security_events
    UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT region) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics

SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS critical
FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
WHERE severity_clean='CRITICAL'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS major
FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
WHERE severity_clean='MAJOR'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.alarms
       GROUP BY region
       ORDER BY value DESC
       LIMIT 8

WITH c AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='MAJOR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS major,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='MINOR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) AS nodes
  FROM iceberg.noc.network_events
)
SELECT 'Riyadh' city, 24.7136 latitude, 46.6753 longitude, total AS value FROM c
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Jeddah', 21.4858, 39.1925, critical FROM c
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Dammam', 26.4207, 50.0888, major FROM c
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Makkah', 21.3891, 39.8579, minor FROM c
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Madinah', 24.5247, 39.5692, nodes FROM c

SELECT severity_clean AS severity, COUNT(*) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.alarms
       GROUP BY severity_clean
       ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (12.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics

SELECT severity_clean AS priority, COUNT(*) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.tickets
       GROUP BY severity_clean
       ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS threats
FROM iceberg.noc.security_events
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (10.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics

SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics
       GROUP BY region
       ORDER BY value DESC
       LIMIT 6

SELECT ROUND(100.0 - (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)),2) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.tickets
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.security_events WHERE severity_clean='CRITICAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.network_events WHERE severity_clean='MAJOR'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) AS value FROM iceberg.noc.alarms

SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS alarms
FROM iceberg.noc.alarms
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT severity_clean AS severity, COUNT(*) AS value
       FROM iceberg.noc.security_events
       GROUP BY severity_clean

panels.description: Demo analytical tables: alarms, tickets, network_events, security_events, performance_metrics

targets.rawSql: SELECT 5 AS value

SELECT event_id AS "Event ID",
              node_id AS "Node",
              region AS "Region",
              severity_clean AS "Severity",
              event_timestamp AS "Time"
       FROM iceberg.noc.alarms
       WHERE severity_clean IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR')
       ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
       LIMIT 40

SELECT event_id AS "Ticket ID",
              source AS "Source",
              region AS "Region",
              severity_clean AS "Priority",
              event_timestamp AS "Created"
       FROM iceberg.noc.tickets
       ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
       LIMIT 40

SELECT event_id AS "Event ID",
              node_id AS "Node",
              region AS "Region",
              severity_clean AS "Threat",
              event_timestamp AS "Time"
       FROM iceberg.noc.security_events
       ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
       LIMIT 40
